variants.name: .223 Rem
variants.info: Load your Scout rifle with .223, a more common civilian ammunition with slightly improved handling characteristics and even more abysmal body damage.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 9.5x59mmRB
variants.info: Change the ammunition fired from your Scout rifle into 9.5x59mmRB for big game hunting. This larger bore round is much more potent in closer engagements, and increases muzzle velocity. However, magazine capacity is severely reduced and rounds must be reloaded manually.
